name: quota-keepalive
description: Watches the plan's 5-hour and weekly limits beside the chat, warns at set thresholds, and keeps the main session's and paused subagents' prompt caches warm until the reset.

headsUpPercent.title: Heads-up percent
headsUpPercent.description: Heads-up at this percent of any window

subagentsStopPercent.title: Subagents stop percent
subagentsStopPercent.description: Running subagents stop at this percent of the 5-hour limit

mainStopPercent.title: Main stop percent
mainStopPercent.description: Main session stops starting work at this percent of the 5-hour limit

weekStopPercent.title: Weekly stop percent
weekStopPercent.description: Stop and tell the person at this percent of a weekly limit
